title: plugin-security: `collectRLSPolicies` applies an object's declared default row scope when no held set carries a policy for it — the platform identity objects stop depending on every set copying the same literals (#24164 ruling E′)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) from objectstack-ai/objectstack#24164, ruled E′ (batch #365 item 4). The collection-point half. ⛔ Not a claim. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.
Blocked-by: #24338
Blocked-by: #24339

## What changes
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` `collectRLSPolicies` (the one collection every read, write and explain door uses; the call at `:5325`, its contract at `:1495` and `:1907`): after collecting the held sets' policies for an object, if the collection is empty and the object declares a default row scope (#24338), the default's policy applies. An authored policy, where present, is used as authored. Superuser-bypass principals are untouched (decided before the collection). Objects with no declared default keep today's behaviour.
- Explain names the object's default when it applies (an 「object default」 source, not a set name).
- The shipped sets keep spreading `scimProjectionRowScope`, `privateCredentialRowScope`, the `_self` / `_org_members` literals and `sys_audit_log_org` as today, so their behaviour and explain output do not move; removing the duplication is a follow-up the `domain:services` seat files after this card's pins hold.

## Pins (tests beside, ruling item 6)
- A principal with no baseline, holding only an authored `'*'` read set, reads only its own `sys_user`, `sys_session` and `sys_scim_user` rows plus its organisation's members on `sys_user` (with the declarations card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164)'s declarations in the fixture, or a test object that declares a default).
- An authored policy on such an object is applied as authored.
- The platform administrator is unchanged.
- Explain names the object default.
- A deployment with the baseline is byte-for-byte unchanged (precedent pins: #20023, #20033).

## Acceptance
- `fix(plugin-security)!`, one BREAKING line, the ADR-0087 marker the gate prints; changeset `minor` under the launch-window convention.
- `pnpm check` green; precedent size #20023 (+510/−1), #20033 (+394/−0).
